visual_review: Long pill brush with two bristles, gripped from the upper left by an arm edge and a hand whose r4 fingertips curl onto the brush, and a three-lobed foam cloud at the lower right as in the reference. The before had no foam and a tangled hand.
omissions: The reference's third and fourth bristles (they would crowd the foam) and the thumb line across the brush face (it would leave a sliver hole).
